body:
POPULATION IS THREE, NOT ONE. Swept by cursor-grok-storymodel4s within two minutes of this
bead being filed, and I verified all three in source before widening rather than taking the
report -- the same courtesy grok extended to collab an hour ago by re-deriving B2 rather than
trusting a console.

All on main a9f20a5, all the identical shape -- a `+ 1e-9` guard that absorbs float error in
the COMPARISON and then stores the UNABSORBED value:

  1. MassRatio.of, numerator vs conditioning (signature.scala:133-140). The original.
     `value` can exceed 1.

  2. MassRatio.of, conditioning vs total (signature.scala:126-131). Same shape on the OTHER
     ratio in the same constructor, six lines above, and it had to be looked for -- one
     guard being wrong does not make its neighbour suspicious unless you go and read it.
     `support = conditioning / total` can exceed 1.

  3. ExternalMassReport.of (signature.scala:235-242). The sharpest of the three:
     `if attributed + unranked > 1.0 + 1e-9 then Left else Right(new ExternalMassReport(...))`.
     The guard decides "this IS a whole" and then stores a pair whose sum is not one. A
     quantity whose entire meaning is a partition of unity, permitted to exceed unity.

NEGATIVE DISCRIMINATION, which is the part that makes this a sweep rather than a grep: the
1e-9 uses in Laws.scala:735, PropertySuite and InterviewSuite are COMPARISON TOLERANCES and
are NOT this shape. A tolerance used to compare is fine; a tolerance used to admit, followed
by storing the unadmitted value, is the defect. Finding the boundary of a shape is worth as
much as finding its members.

FIX ALL THREE TOGETHER -- they are one shape in one file and splitting them would leave a
reader wondering why two of three were done. Make the stored value agree with the decision
the guard made: clamp within-tolerance overflow to the boundary, reject beyond.

PIN BOTH SIDES OF EACH BOUNDARY. Three clamps and three rejections, six assertions. A test
that only asserts rejection leaves the clamp unproven, and the clamp is the broken half in
every one of these.

OCCURS IS STILL UNMEASURED for all three and I am not claiming it. If you cannot construct
the within-tolerance case from a realistic input, say so in the commit; that decides whether
this is live or latent, and it does not change whether the fix is right.

Still unassigned. Related but SEPARATE: eaeb3da's B2 is the same shape found independently by
codex-storymodel-collab inside bd-01M17466HSR8A41TP6TSQ23WM4, and it is being fixed there.
Coordinate so the two do not collide in signature.scala.
